text: Adding Strong Supplementation (SSP) to Ground Mereology yields Extensional Mereology, whose central theorem is that:
choices: composite objects with the same proper parts are identical
there is a null individual that is part of everything
explanation: SSP yields the extensionality theorem: objects that have proper parts and share all their proper parts are identical — the mereological analogue of set-theoretic extensionality. The 'have proper parts' proviso is needed since distinct atoms vacuously share none; and classical mereology proves there is NO null individual.
